We want to perform gene set enrichment of ERAP2 KD proteomics data.

### Load annotation file

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("rtracklayer")

```

- Load ERAP2 KD proteomics

```{r}

significant_events_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-03-significantly-affected-proteins.rds"))
pairwise_group_sig_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-04-pairwise-grouped-significantly-affected-proteins.rds"))

```

### 5.0 Perform gene set enrichment

- Perform gene set enrichment of genes

```{r}

imputed_event_df <- significant_events_df[significant_events_df$sig_group == "imputed",]

protein_split <- split(imputed_event_df, imputed_event_df$comparison)
protein_split <- protein_split[c("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2")]

dbs <- c("GO_Biological_Process_2023", "HMDB_Metabolites")
groups <- names(protein_split)
directions <- c("up", "down")
kd_geneset_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]
    return_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
            db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
                message(paste(a_database, a_direction, a_group))
                current_fcs <- a_temp_df$logfc[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                current_genes <- a_temp_df$protein_name[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
                if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
                    return(NULL)
                }
                an_enrichment_df$direction <- a_direction
                an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
                an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
                Sys.sleep(5)
                return(an_enrichment_df)
            })
            db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
        }))
    return_df$contrasts <- a_group
    return(return_df)
}))

kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Gene.ratio <- vapply(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)


pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "02-07-unimputed-data-GOBP-gene-set-enrichment.pdf"))
groups <- unique(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$contrasts)
directions <- c("up", "down")
lapply(unique(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$db), function(a_database){
    lapply(groups, function(a_group){
        lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
            message(a_group, a_database)
            current_n <- unique(kd_geneset_enrichment_df[
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$contrasts == a_group &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$direction == a_direction &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$db == a_database, "num_gene"])
            plot_df <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05 &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$contrasts == a_group &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$db == a_database &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$direction == a_direction,]
            if(nrow(plot_df) > 0){
                plotEnrich(plot_df, showTerms = 10, numChar = 50, y = "Ratio", orderBy = "Gene.ratio", title = paste(a_database, paste("\n",a_group), a_direction, "N=",current_n))
            }else{
                return(NULL)
            }
        })
    })
})

dev.off()


```




```{r}

groups <- names(protein_split)
directions <- c("up", "down")
biological_process_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]
    return_df_1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
        current_gene_list_df <- a_temp_df[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction,]
        current_gene_list_df <- current_gene_list_df[,c(2,3,4)]
        current_object <- GPT_summarisR(current_gene_list_df, organism = "human", enrichment_method = "enrich")
        enrichment_object <- run_enrichment(current_object, go_db = "BP")
        filtered_enrichment_object <- filter_results(enrichment_object, 
            pvalue = 0.05)
        clustering_object <- run_clustering(filtered_enrichment_object)
        plot_clustering_qc_plots(clustering_object, 
            file = file.path(plot_dir, paste("BP", a_group, a_direction, "silhouette_qc_plot.pdf", sep = "-")))
        summarised_object <- summarise_clusters(clustering_object, 10)
        plot_enrichment(summarised_object, k = 10, 
            y_axis = "pvalue",
            file = file.path(plot_dir, paste("BP", a_group, a_direction, "enrichment.pdf", sep = "-")))
        return_df <- fetch_summarised_enrichment_results(summarised_object)
        return_df$direction <- a_direction
        return(return_df)
    }))
    return_df_1$contrasts <- a_group 
    return(return_df_1)
}))
biological_process_enrichment_df$db <- "BP"
```

- concatenate all results

```{r}

concatenate_df <- rbind(biological_process_enrichment_df, cellular_component_enrichment_df, molecular_function_enrichment_df)

split_df <- split(concatenate_df, 
    paste(concatenate_df$db, concatenate_df$contrasts, concatenate_df$direction, sep = "_"))

top_10_terms_list <- lapply(split_df, function(x){
    x[grepl(x = x$Description, pattern = "lipi"),]
})



```
